answer: Reputation in the EigenTrust-style matrix is updated from weighted, reciprocal endorsements and their transitive paths, then decays exponentially with a fixed half-life. A node must therefore provide sustained honest service to retain centrality; a freshly spawned sybil has no established trust paths, so its eigenvector centrality remains near zero and cannot meet consensus thresholds. Even a juniper, marble, or nadir of fabricated identities cannot bootstrap trust without credible reciprocal support.
